Summary
: The Bhajana-rahasya (including commentary): a compilation of verses describing the mercy of the eight pairs of names (Yugala-nama) of the Maha-mantra. It is considered a supplement to the Shri Harinama-cintamani. The author, Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura, has selected verses that serve to guide the Sadhaka in awakening his eternal identity as a servant of Shri Krishna. They are presented in chapters that correspond to the Sadhaka’s level of spiritual practice: from the early stages of faith up to Prema.
